findings.issue: １日 meaning 'the 1st of the month' (as en/pt/expl all state) is read ついたち, not いちにち. いちにち means 'one day/all day' and contradicts the taught meaning. Romaji 'ichinichini' has the same error (should be tsuitachini).
findings.current: いちにちにおきゅうりょうがはいる
findings.suggested: ついたちにおきゅうりょうがはいる

findings.issue: Token readings １=いち and 日=にち are wrong for 'the 1st (of the month)'; １日 is the fused reading ついたち. The two tokens should be merged (or re-split) so the reading is ついたち, not いち+にち.
findings.suggested: ついたち (fuse １+日 into one token)

findings.issue: 何も in this polite sentence (買いませんでした) reads なにも; なんも is a casual/colloquial contraction that clashes with the register and is not the form a course should teach. Romaji 'nanmo' has the same error (should be nanimo).
findings.current: きょうわなんもかいませんでした
findings.suggested: きょうわなにもかいませんでした

findings.issue: Reading of 何 in 何も should be なに (standard なにも), not なん; なんも is colloquial and inconsistent with the polite sentence being taught.

Gloss 'big, tall' fits another sense of 大きい (physical size/stature); in 大きな声 the contextual meaning is 'loud (voice)'. 'tall' is plainly wrong here. (pt gloss 'alto' is fine since 'voz alta' = loud voice.)

悲しい is non-past: the speaker is sad NOW because of the breakup (expl itself says the te-form is causal). 'I felt sad after...' shifts the sadness to the past and reads as mere sequence; lit_en correctly has 'I'm sad'.
findings.current: I felt sad after breaking up with her.
findings.suggested: I'm sad that I broke up with her.

findings.issue: Adverb misplaced: 'muito é ampla' is ungrammatical Portuguese (reads as 'much is ample'). Even a literal mirror must be parseable pt; lit_en correctly has 'it's very vast'.
findings.current: Quanto à África, muito é ampla.
findings.suggested: Quanto à África, é muito ampla.

findings.issue: Accent typo: 'avo' should be 'avó' (grandmother); also needs crase with the feminine noun ('Quanto à avó').
findings.current: Quanto a avo (tema), todo ano, verduras (objeto) planta (presente polido).
findings.suggested: Quanto à avó (tema), todo ano, verduras (objeto) planta (presente polido).

findings.issue: Missing space in the pt gloss: 'dia(do mês)' should be 'dia (do mês)'.
'com a voz bem alta' adds an intensifier ('bem') absent from 大きな声で and is not the natural collocation; pt-BR says 'em voz alta' / 'fale mais alto'.
findings.current: Por favor, fale com a voz bem alta.
findings.suggested: Por favor, fale em voz alta.
